# What The Fab

> > What The Fab is a lifestyle publication covering beauty product recommendations, travel guides, and practical how-to content with a focus on K-beauty brands like COSRX, Klairs, and Peach & Lily.

The site specializes in curated product reviews and travel recommendations, featuring detailed guides on Korean skincare products, beauty tools optimized for Asian features, vacation destinations, and lifestyle tips. Content is presented in accessible web story format with actionable recommendations.

## Key Topics

- K-beauty
- Korean skincare products
- COSRX
- Klairs
- Peach & Lily
- Product recommendations
- Travel guides
- Caribbean cruises
- Instagram account security
- Skincare serums and cleansers
- Asian fit beauty products
- Vacation planning
- Beauty product reviews
- Resort wear and cruise fashion
- Social media security

## Korean Beauty & Skincare

- [4 Best Korean Serums for Glowy Skin](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/korean-serums): Korean serum recommendations from Klairs, COSRX, and Peach & Lily brands
- [3 BEST Korean Cleansers: Tried and Tested](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/best-korean-cleansers): Tested Korean facial cleanser reviews including COSRX and Isntree products

## Beauty Products & Tools

- [Vegamour Review: 3 BEST Products to Try](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/vegamour-review): Vegamour hair growth serum review covering brow, lash, and hair products
- [3 BEST Eyelash Curlers for Asian Eyes](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/best-eyelash-curlers-for-asian-eyes): Eyelash curler recommendations for Asian eyes including Shu Uemura
- [4 BEST Asian Fit Sunglasses for Comfort and Style](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/asian-fit-sunglasses): Asian fit sunglasses guide featuring Covry and Mohala Eyewear brands
- [4 BEST Stretch Mark Oils and Creams for Pregnancy](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/best-stretch-mark-oils-for-pregnancy): Pregnancy stretch mark prevention products from Palmer's and Earth Mama

## Travel Guides & Destinations

- [4 Best US Beaches to Visit This Year](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/best-us-beaches): Top US beach destinations in Hawaii, Oregon, and Florida for vacations
- [4 BEST Day Trips Near Phoenix](https://whatthefab.com/web-stories/day-trips-near-phoenix): Phoenix day trip guide to Sedona, Scottsdale, and Arizona state parks
